text: #929: @gitdek chose its steps 1 and 2 on 2026-11-19, to be built by hand. A part of a repository's contract can declare that it builds on macOS, and CI's gate then builds, vets and tests that part on a GitHub-hosted macOS runner, as a second job that branch protection requires like the first. Tests that need no permission run there too, such as a self-test that feeds made-up input through the real code. A part that needs a Mac is never reported as checked when only the Linux job ran, and a repository with no such part runs exactly as before. Step 3, the factory building such a part on a Mac, gets an issue of its own when it's taken.
